summary: Iteration 77: UX fixes for Executive Dashboard and Configuration Page - All tests passed. Verified Health Score messaging, Quick Navigation icons, parameter descriptions, save button labels, and numeric clamping.

TEST_01_dashboard_loads.notes: Executive Dashboard loads at /dashboard with data-testid='executive-dashboard-page'

TEST_02_kpi_cards.notes: 4 KPI cards present: Revenue, Units Sold, MRP Realisation, Health Score

TEST_03_health_score_no_data_message.notes: Health Score KPI shows 'Upload data to calculate' when no module data

TEST_04_health_score_circle_message.notes: Health Score circle shows 'No module data uploaded yet' when hasModuleData=false

TEST_06_quick_navigation_unique_icons.notes: All 12 icons are unique: Activity, TrendingDown, XCircle, ShoppingCart, Clock, Layout, BarChart3, Package, Upload, Server, Database, MessageCircle

TEST_09_config_page_loads.notes: Configuration page loads at /config with data-testid='configuration-page'

TEST_10_save_button_params_tab.notes: Save button shows 'Save Parameters & Modules' on Parameters tab

TEST_11_save_button_modules_tab.notes: Save button shows 'Save Parameters & Modules' on Modules tab

TEST_12_save_button_hidden_stores.notes: Save button hidden on Store Classes tab, shows 'saved individually' hint

TEST_13_save_button_hidden_categories.notes: Save button hidden on Categories tab, shows 'saved individually' hint

TEST_14_8_parameter_fields.notes: 8 parameter fields with improved descriptions: PSA Benchmark, Cover Days, ROS Period, Ideal DOH, Topseller X Factor, Lead Time Days, Safety Stock Days, Min Shelf Life Days

TEST_15_5_module_toggles.notes: 5 module toggles with descriptive text: NOOS, ROS Gap, Size Set Gap, Lifecycle, Replenishment

TEST_16_numeric_clamping.notes: PF component clamps values within min/max range using Math.min(max, Math.max(min, num))

TEST_17_save_functionality.notes: Save button works - shows 'Configuration saved' success message

ExecutiveDashboard.js: Health Score KPI shows 'Upload data to calculate' when no data (line 348)
Health Score circle shows 'No module data uploaded yet' (getScoreLabel function, line 198)
Configuration.js: Save button shows 'Save Parameters & Modules' on params/modules tabs (line 69)
Store Classes/Categories tabs show 'saved individually' hint (line 72)
Numeric input clamping in PF component (lines 101-106)
